2. **Add a decision-first comparison table above the fold**
   Use a compact table immediately after the introduction—not buried below reviews.

   | Category | AeroGarden Bounty Elite | Click & Grow Smart Garden | Best for |
   |---|---|---|---|
   | Growing method | Water-based hydroponics; liquid nutrients | Soil-like pods with passive wicking | Lowest maintenance: Click & Grow |
   | Plant capacity | 9 pods | Model-dependent | More crop flexibility: AeroGarden |
   | Light/grow height | 50W dimmable light; up to 24 inches | Lower-power light; shorter practical clearance | Tomatoes and peppers: AeroGarden |
   | Upkeep | Add water and nutrients; pump produces some noise | Add water; no pump or liquid nutrients | Quiet simplicity: Click & Grow |
   | Best apartment use | Larger harvests and taller plants | Herbs with minimal setup | Depends on counter space |
